![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Pass `paths?.projectionIn` to `projectionRows` to ensure that any diagnostics recorded use the correct custom path instead of the hardcoded default path.

```suggestion
  const rows = projectionRows(projection, diagnostics, paths?.projectionIn);
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. In validation scripts, convert source-artifact path, read, or shape problems into stable validator warning/failure metadata instead of throwing raw parser or load failures, and keep strictly required dependencies as explicit required arguments.
</details>
Fixed in 6b6be2866 on PR #1223. buildReceipt now passes paths?.projectionIn into projectionRows, with regression coverage for custom projection paths and missing-input diagnostics.

Fixed in 6b6be2866 on PR #1223. projectionRows now accepts a projectionInPath, returns without adding a duplicate shape diagnostic when safeReadJson already failed with null/undefined, and records malformed shape diagnostics against the configured projection path.
